chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Billy Kyle's playing; Buster Bailey and Red Allen in Millinder's band
summary: Kyle swung commandingly while sitting straight and was good-looking; Buster Bailey and Red Allen also played with Millinder.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: What did you like mostly about Billy Kyle? What kind of piano player was he?
Billy to me was an exciting piano player and swing, too, and it was very commanding to me the way he would swing a piano. And he'd sit just as straight at the piano and play.
Oh, yeah. Yeah, he was a very good-looking guy. The ladies liked him.
And Buster Bailey was in that band, too, for a while, you know. He was with Lucky. So was Red Allen.
Right. -- came out of that band.
That's right. But that's when I knew Billy Kyle, just before he went out with John Kirby.
